description: A multi-account parcel tracking service built with TypeScript and PostgreSQL.
reviewConcerns: Every account-scoped read and write enforces account isolation.
Webhook requests are authenticated before their payloads are parsed.
Retryable jobs are idempotent and never duplicate notifications.
architectureRules: HTTP handlers call application services instead of database adapters directly.
Public response types are defined in src/contracts before handler implementation.
State changes emit an append-only activity event in the same transaction.

pathTierRules.reason: Database migrations can affect stored data and access controls.
Authentication code defines a trust boundary.
Billing changes can create financial side effects.
Documentation-only changes use the reduced review bench.

codex.label: Correctness and data integrity
codex.prompt: Focus on transaction boundaries, idempotency, state transitions, and data-loss risks.

claude.label: Security and API contracts
claude.prompt: Focus on authorization, untrusted inputs, secret handling, and public API compatibility.

grok.label: Generalist and failure modes
grok.prompt: Review the whole diff for anything the specialist lenses may miss, with extra attention to error handling, retry and timeout behaviour, partial-failure paths, and what breaks under load or when a dependency is unavailable.
